2610.09890.title: Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions
2610.09890.paper_summary: Inverse optimization estimates the weights of an objective function that explain observed decisions as optimal solutions, and is used in a variety of fields. For mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), existing methods aim to reproduce the observations as optimal solutions, and thus learn compromise weights when the observations are suboptimal. We propose outperformance inverse optimization, which instead seeks weights that induce, at each state, an optimal solution outperforming the observed action in every component. We give a loss function that can be evaluated with forward-problem oracles alone and is thus applicable to MILPs, together with gradient-based and DC optimization algorithms for minimizing it. For weights inducing a unique outperforming optimal solution at all observations, we prove that the probability of failing to induce such a solution at a new state (the generalization error) is bounded by a quantity inversely proportional to the number of observations, and that this bound is tight in the number of observations up to logarithmic factors. In experiments on synthetic and real data, the proposed methods improve the prediction of solutions outperforming the actions over existing methods.
2610.09890.paper_summary_zh: 逆向優化估計目標函數的權重，以解釋觀察到的決策作為最佳解，並在多個領域中使用。對於混合整數線性規劃（MILPs），現有方法旨在重現觀察結果作為最佳解，因此在觀察結果不理想時學習妥協權重。我們提出了超越逆向優化，該方法尋求在每個狀態下誘導一個在每個組件上超越觀察行動的最佳解。我們給出了一個損失函數，可以僅用前向問題預言機進行評估，因此適用於MILPs，並提供基於梯度的和DC優化算法來最小化它。對於在所有觀察中誘導唯一超越最佳解的權重，我們證明在新狀態下無法誘導此類解的概率（泛化誤差）由一個與觀察數量成反比的量界定，並且這個界限在觀察數量上是緊密的，直到對數因子。在合成數據和實際數據的實驗中，所提出的方法改善了對超越行動的解的預測，優於現有方法。
2610.09890.author: Akira Kitaoka et.al.
